name: abakus-one-storage-rules-tests
description: Emulator-backed Storage Security Rules tests for Phase 9 Sprint 9H (docs/decisions.md ADR-026), extended P.4.2A (Profile photo upload grants) to also run the Firestore Emulator alongside Storage - storage.rules now reads Firestore cross-service (firestore.get) to verify upload grants, which requires both emulators running together. No real Firebase project credentials are used or required.

scripts.test:emulator: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage "cd storage-tests && npm test"
